name: Kisaragi Ayano
source:
Ayano is a widow and mother of the three Kisaragi sisters. Based on her youthful appearance nobody would guess she already has three grown up children.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=3378]Getchu[/url].]
